## ▸ About

Analytics & Data Engineer with **4 years** building end-to-end data solutions for high-volume B2C products. I've migrated legacy architectures to a **modern lakehouse (medallion)**, built a business unit's data foundation **from scratch** at Mercado Livre, and **cut dashboard build time by 50%** across LATAM at Rappi. I work with **Python, SQL, PySpark, dbt, Airflow, Databricks, BigQuery, Snowflake and CI/CD**, delivering governed, self-service analytics through **Tableau, Power BI and Looker**.

**Currently**
- 💼 Open to **Analytics Engineer / Data Engineer** opportunities
- 🏗️ Focused on **lakehouse architecture, data modeling and semantic layers**
- 🛡️ Advocating **data quality, governance and documentation** as part of the product

## ▸ Experience

**Analytics Engineer · [Mercado Livre](https://www.mercadolivre.com.br/)** <sub>São Paulo · 05/2024 – 04/2026</sub>
- Built the **Seller Experience** business unit's data area from scratch: architecture, modeling, security and governance standards used across multiple operations
- Shipped a **medallion ELT pipeline** (bronze → silver → gold) on Databricks with PySpark and dbt, processing millions of rows with **26 dbt quality tests**, orchestrated by Databricks Workflows and CI on GitHub Actions
- Migrated analytical tables to **BigQuery domains following Data Mesh** principles, with semantic layers and Dataflow automation for consistent metrics across teams
- Consolidated **13 seller-logistics SLA KPIs** from ~20 tables into a single source of truth on Tableau and Power BI
- Integrated **Qualtrics → BigQuery** via API (Dataflow) to bring courier surveys and feedback into Tableau in near real-time

**Data Analyst · [Rappi](https://www.rappi.com.br/)** <sub>São Paulo · 06/2022 – 04/2024</sub>
- Delivered LATAM dashboards in Power BI and Tableau refreshed **in under 30 min**, including the Smart Audience panel
- **Cut new dashboard build time by 50%** by designing and documenting reusable layout templates
- Replaced manual processes with **Snowflake ETL pipelines orchestrated by Airflow**
- Applied **K-means clustering**, outlier detection and **price-elasticity analysis (IQR)** to guide survey targeting and commercial pricing decisions
- Contributed to **Data Governance**, documenting technical standards in Confluence
